rationales: 1890 is not the year Moseley established the concept of atomic number.
1900 is not the year Moseley established the concept of atomic number.

1920 is later than Moseley’s discovery of atomic number.

Ten is not the number of elements in the second period.
Eighteen is the number of elements in some longer periods, not the second.

Solubility describes the maximum amount of solute that dissolves under specified conditions.
A suspension is a heterogeneous mixture with dispersed particles.
A colloid is a mixture with particles intermediate in size between a solution and a suspension.
Molarity is the number of moles of solute per dm³ of solution.
A covalent bond forms by sharing electrons, not transferring them.
An ionic bond forms through electron transfer between atoms.
A metallic bond involves attraction between metal ions and delocalized electrons.
A coordinate bond forms when one atom donates both bonding electrons.

600 °C is too low for sodium chloride’s melting point.
Sodium chloride melts at about 801 °C, conventionally rounded to 800 °C.
1000 °C is higher than sodium chloride’s melting point.
Fog consists of tiny liquid water droplets dispersed in a gas (air).

Cheese is not a liquid dispersed in a gas.
Brass is a solid alloy, not a liquid-in-gas solution.
Sugar solution does not produce ions and is a non-electrolyte.

Rubber is an electrical insulator, not an electrolyte.

Fluorine is a gas at room temperature.
Iodine is a solid at room temperature.
